full_prompt_en: A square contemporary oil painting shows a young woman's face emerging from a cloud of pale blue and white painterly textures against a cool blue-gray ground. The background remains shallow and abstract, marked by scraped strokes, faint warm scuffs, and thin lines that cross the surface without forming a recognizable place. Her head fills most of the central frame, turned three-quarters toward the left, with the chin low and the gaze lifted beyond the upper-left edge. Soft brown eyebrows and dark lashes give the eyes a thoughtful focus. Warm peach and rose tones model the nose, cheeks, and parted lips, while translucent blue-gray shadow cools the side of the face and neck. Her light hair is barely separated from the pale surrounding paint. Around the forehead and both sides of the head, broad white and bluish strokes fold and curl like an airy wrap or loose fabric, but many edges dissolve before a definite garment can be identified. A few thicker, palette-knife-like deposits stand proud around the right temple, contrasting with the smoothly modeled skin. At the bottom, the neck and shoulders fade into pale paint instead of ending at a hard outline. Fine scratched and dragged marks reveal a layered surface beneath the soft color. Light seems to arrive from above and the left, brightening the forehead, nose, cheek, and upper lip, while a gentler cool shadow supports the lower right side. No readable text appears. The overall composition is intimate and contemplative, balancing a carefully observed face against broken, almost sculptural patches of cool paint and warm skin color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形当代油画呈现一位年轻女子的面庞，从浅蓝与白色的绘画肌理云团中浮现，背景是冷调蓝灰色。后景浅而抽象，留有刮擦笔触、淡暖色磨痕和穿过画面的细线，却没有形成可辨认的地点。她的头部占据中央大部分画幅，向左转成四分之三侧面，下巴略低，目光抬向左上边缘之外。柔和的棕色眉毛和深色睫毛使眼神显得专注而沉思。暖桃色与玫瑰色塑造鼻子、脸颊和微张的嘴唇，半透明蓝灰阴影则冷却面部一侧与颈部。浅色头发几乎与周围淡色颜料连在一起。额头与头部两侧，宽阔的白色和微蓝笔触像轻盈的包裹物或松散布料一样折转卷曲，但许多边缘在形成确定衣物之前便溶解。右侧太阳穴附近几处较厚、类似调色刀涂抹的颜料凸起，与平滑塑造的皮肤形成对照。画面下方，颈部和肩膀淡入浅色颜料，没有以硬轮廓结束。细小刮痕和拖拉笔迹显出柔色下方的层叠表面。光似乎来自上方偏左，照亮额头、鼻子、脸颊和上唇，较柔和的冷影托住右下侧。画面没有可读文字。整体构图亲密而沉思，以细致观察的面庞平衡冷色颜料破碎、近乎雕塑般的色块与暖肤色。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting contrasts softly blended warm modeling with cool, fractured applications of opaque paint. Pale blue-gray, chalky white, blush peach, and muted rose form a restrained palette in which small warm regions carry attention. Broad dragged strokes, scraped lines, and thicker knife-like deposits give the surrounding surface visible physical depth. Some edges are delicately observed and crisp; others break apart into translucent veils or rough angular patches. The composition holds a smooth focal area within a loose halo of active texture, allowing representational clarity to dissolve gradually into abstraction. Diffuse high light brightens selected raised passages and leaves cool shadow in the recesses, rather than producing a hard theatrical spotlight. Faint underlying marks remain visible through thin layers and make the surface feel revised and lived in. The overall effect is tender and contemplative, with tactile material contrasts doing as much work as the quiet color harmony.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油画把柔和调和的暖色塑形与冷色、破碎的不透明颜料涂抹相对照。浅蓝灰、粉笔白、淡桃色和低饱和玫瑰色构成克制配色，少量暖色区域承担视线焦点。宽阔拖笔、刮擦线痕和较厚的调色刀般颜料堆积赋予周围表面可见的实体纵深。有些边缘被细腻观察而清晰，有些则碎开为半透明薄层或粗糙棱角色块。构图让平滑的焦点区域处于松散而活跃的肌理光环内，使可辨的形体逐渐溶入抽象。漫射的高处光照亮有选择的凸起颜料，让冷影留在凹处，而不形成生硬的戏剧性聚光。隐约的底层笔痕透过薄涂依然可见，使画面表面带有反复修改后的生活感。整体效果温柔而沉思，可触的材料对照与安静的色彩和谐同样重要。
theme_en: A young woman's upward gaze emerging from pale blue painted textures
theme_zh: 一位年轻女子抬眼凝视，从浅蓝绘画肌理中浮现
name: Meredith Marsone
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
